title: Target’s beauty sales grow 9% with Target Beauty Studio debut
summary: US retailer Target is strengthening its ‘position as a leading beauty destination’ with the launch of Target Beauty Studios at more than 600 stores, offering 90 new brands across skin care, fragrance and hair care

extraction.key_fact: 미국 유통사 타깃이 다수 매장에 타깃 뷰티 스튜디오를 열어 뷰티 사업을 강화하고 있다.
